name: Wireless Device Manager Pro
description:
Turn Stream Deck into a wireless device dashboard for Windows.

Wireless Device Manager Pro combines Bluetooth device status, wireless battery visibility, low-battery alerts, favorites, device groups, and capability-gated connect/disconnect control in one place. Give dedicated keys to headphones, a headset, keyboard, mouse, controller, earbuds, or other supported Bluetooth devices that Windows exposes.

Every detected device advertises its own STATUS, CONNECT, DISCONNECT, BATTERY, and CHARGING capabilities. Battery percentage and charging state are never invented. If Windows or the device does not expose telemetry, PackRat marks that capability unavailable. Connect/disconnect appears only where the Windows Bluetooth service path is supported.

Create groups such as GAMING, WORK, or TRAVEL to organize and summarize the devices you care about. Groups are status/organization tools; PackRat does not blindly auto-connect every Bluetooth device. Favorites power Cycle Device, while Device Dashboard gives a multi-device status view. Per-device low-battery thresholds can alert you on Stream Deck when a supported battery drops below your chosen level.

Ready-made Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+ and Stream Deck Neo profiles include HEADPHONES, KEYBOARD, MOUSE, CONTROLLER and ALL DEVICES layouts. Stream Deck+ uses keys only because a dial would add no legitimate wireless-device control.

Windows 10 or newer. No separate companion app, account, or cloud service is required.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Multi-device Bluetooth status and battery dashboard
- Favorites, Cycle Device, and GAMING / WORK / TRAVEL multi-group organization
- Per-device low-battery thresholds with Stream Deck alerts
- Capability-gated audio connect/disconnect on supported devices
- Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+, and Neo key-only profiles
